depth_targets.title: Connections: Security (SSL/TLS enforcement, client/server certificates)
depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi has no certificate authority and does not negotiate TLS for simulated connections, so it cannot issue client certificates or enforce 'Require SSL/TLS'.

depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi collects no CPU/memory/query telemetry for Cloud SQL instances and has no in-console SQL editor backed by the native Admin API, so these dashboards cannot be rendered from real data.
